blocks.en: Identify all the major regulations, pharmacopoeias and industry standards cited in the ISPE CTC Guide, and understand their relevance to cold chain storage qualification

blocks.zh: 定義關鍵 CTC 認證術語：IQ、OQ、PQ、URS、MKT、MU、guard-banding（保護區間）、最差位置、FAT、SAT、BMS、溫度偏差
blocks.en: Define key CTC qualification terms: IQ, OQ, PQ, URS, MKT, MU, guard-banding, worst-case location, FAT, SAT, BMS, temperature excursion

blocks.zh: 區分溫度儲存類別（冷藏、涼爽、CRT 室溫、冷凍、溫熱、CCT 控溫冷藏）及其藥典定義
blocks.en: Distinguish the temperature storage categories (refrigerated, cool, CRT controlled room temperature, freezer, warm, and CCT controlled cold temperature) and their pharmacopoeial definitions

blocks.zh: 總結指南完整架構——全部 9 個內容章節的目的、輸出文件及主要使用者

blocks.en: Apply the CDMO cold storage qualification checklist across the full IQ/OQ/PQ lifecycle

blocks.zh: 中文解說  |  Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: ISPE CTC 指南的 32 篇參考文獻構成了一個完整的法規生態系統。對 CDMO 而言，這份清單不只是書目，更是稽查準備的優先閱讀清單。
blocks.en: The 32 references in the ISPE CTC Guide form a complete regulatory ecosystem. For a CDMO, this list is more than a bibliography: it is a priority reading list for inspection preparation.

blocks.zh: 為什麼參考文獻很重要？
blocks.en: Why do the references matter?

blocks.zh: 當稽查員問「你的溫度標準依據是什麼？」時，正確的回答應該引用具體文件——例如「依據 USP <659> 定義，2–8°C 儲存符合 Cold 分類」，而不是「依據公司 SOP」。
blocks.en: When an inspector asks, "What is the basis for your temperature standard?", the right answer cites a specific document, for example "Under the USP <659> definition, 2–8°C storage meets the Cold classification", rather than "according to our company SOP".

blocks.zh: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 和 EU GDP 2013 是全球冷鏈最被廣泛引用的文件，幾乎所有市場的監管機關都認可這兩份文件作為基準。
blocks.en: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 and EU GDP 2013 are the most widely cited cold chain documents worldwide; regulators in almost every market accept them as a baseline.

blocks.zh: 類比說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這 32 篇參考文獻就像蓋房子時的建築法規、材料規範和施工準則——每一份都有其具體的適用範圍。ISPE CTC 指南的角色是把這些規範整合成一套可操作的實務框架。
blocks.en: These 32 references are like the building codes, material specifications and construction practices used when building a house: each has its own specific scope. The role of the ISPE CTC Guide is to integrate these requirements into one practical, operable framework.

blocks.zh: Critical References for CDMO Inspections  |  CDMO 稽查必讀文件
blocks.en: Critical References for CDMO Inspections

blocks.zh: CDMO 優先閱讀清單說明
blocks.en: Notes on the CDMO priority reading list

blocks.zh: Critical（必讀）： EU GDP、WHO TRS 961、USP <659>、21 CFR Part 11、EudraLex Annex 11 — 這五份文件是全球大多數市場稽查的核心依據。
blocks.en: Critical (must read): EU GDP, WHO TRS 961, USP <659>, 21 CFR Part 11, EudraLex Annex 11. These five documents are the core basis for inspections in most markets worldwide.

blocks.zh: High（建議熟悉）： ISPE Vol. 5、ASTM E2500、PDA TR52、PDA TR64 — 提供具體的認證方法論支持。
blocks.en: High (should be familiar): ISPE Vol. 5, ASTM E2500, PDA TR52, PDA TR64. They provide specific qualification methodology support.

blocks.zh: Medium（知道即可）： 區域性標準（JTM、DIN、AS）和輔助文件 — 進入特定市場時再深入了解。
blocks.en: Medium (good to know): Regional standards (JTM, DIN, AS) and supporting documents. Study them in more depth when entering a specific market.

blocks.zh: IEC 751 RTD 標準值得特別注意——RTD（鉑電阻溫度計）是藥廠溫度監控的首選感測器，其精度遠優於熱電偶。
blocks.en: The IEC 751 RTD standard deserves special attention. The RTD (resistance temperature detector, platinum) is the preferred sensor for temperature monitoring in pharmaceutical plants, and its accuracy is far better than that of a thermocouple.

blocks.en: Key Terms Commentary

blocks.zh: 最重要的縮寫群組
blocks.en: The most important acronym groups

blocks.zh: 認證四步： IQ → OQ → PQ（+ FAT/SAT）— 認識這四個縮寫的順序和意義是 CTC 認證的基礎知識。
blocks.en: The four qualification steps: IQ → OQ → PQ (+ FAT/SAT). Knowing these acronyms, their order and their meaning is basic knowledge for CTC qualification.

blocks.zh: 監控核心： BMS、RTD、MU、CPP、CQA — 這五個縮寫涵蓋了監控系統設計的核心概念。
blocks.en: Monitoring core: BMS, RTD, MU, CPP, CQA. These five acronyms cover the core concepts of monitoring system design.

blocks.zh: 法規框架： GDP、URS、SOP、SME — 這四個縮寫貫穿整份指南的品保框架。
blocks.en: Regulatory framework: GDP, URS, SOP, SME. These four acronyms run through the quality assurance framework of the whole guide.

blocks.zh: 容易混淆的縮寫
blocks.en: Easily confused acronyms

blocks.zh: BAS vs. BMS： BAS（樓宇自動化系統）是廣義概念；BMS（樓宇管理系統）是藥廠習慣用語，兩者常互換使用。重點是：任何用於記錄 GMP 數據的系統都必須符合 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11。
blocks.en: BAS vs. BMS: BAS (building automation system) is the broader concept; BMS (building management system) is the term pharmaceutical plants habitually use, and the two are often used interchangeably. The key point: any system used to record GMP data must comply with 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11.

blocks.zh: RTD vs. 熱電偶： RTD（Pt100 鉑電阻）精度約 ±0.1–0.3°C；熱電偶精度較差（±0.5–2°C）。GMP 藥廠溫度監控優先選用 RTD。
blocks.en: RTD vs. thermocouple: An RTD (Pt100 platinum resistance) has an accuracy of about ±0.1–0.3°C; a thermocouple is less accurate (±0.5–2°C). For GMP temperature monitoring, RTDs are the preferred choice.

blocks.zh: CPP vs. CQA： CQA 是產品的品質屬性（如效價穩定性）；CPP 是影響 CQA 的製程參數（如溫度）。兩者是因果關係。
blocks.en: CPP vs. CQA: A CQA is a quality attribute of the product (such as potency stability); a CPP is a process parameter that affects a CQA (such as temperature). The two have a cause-and-effect relationship.

blocks.zh: MU vs. Accuracy： MU（測量不確定度）是統計概念，包含感測器誤差、校正誤差和環境影響的綜合評估；Accuracy（準確度）只是感測器本身的規格。MU 才是 guard-banding 的計算依據。
blocks.en: MU vs. Accuracy: MU (measurement uncertainty) is a statistical concept that combines sensor error, calibration error and environmental influences; accuracy is only the specification of the sensor itself. MU, not accuracy, is the basis for calculating guard-banding.

blocks.zh: FAT 與 SAT 的差別
blocks.en: The difference between FAT and SAT

blocks.zh: FAT（Factory Acceptance Test）在製造商工廠進行——就像在汽車工廠驗收新車，確認基本功能正常。
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) is performed at the manufacturer's plant, like inspecting a new car at the car factory to confirm that its basic functions work.

blocks.zh: SAT（Site Acceptance Test）在使用者場地進行——就像把新車開到自己的停車場後再做一次確認，確認在實際環境下仍然正常運作。
blocks.en: SAT (Site Acceptance Test) is performed at the user's site, like driving the new car to your own parking lot and checking it again to confirm that it still works properly in the real environment.

blocks.zh: 在 CTC 認證中，FAT 驗證設備出廠規格，SAT 驗證安裝後的現場表現，兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: In CTC qualification, FAT verifies the equipment's as-shipped specification and SAT verifies its on-site performance after installation; both are indispensable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical application for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在撰寫 URS 時，建議將縮寫清單附在文件末尾作為定義附錄。這樣不僅方便閱讀，也能在稽查時展示文件完整性。
blocks.en: When writing a URS, we recommend attaching the acronym list at the end of the document as a definitions appendix. This makes the document easier to read and also demonstrates document completeness during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 建立一份統一的 GMP 術語縮寫表（包含 CTC、HVAC、EMS 等系統），供所有 SOP 和認證文件共同引用，確保一致性。
blocks.en: A CDMO should create one unified GMP acronym list (covering systems such as CTC, HVAC and EMS) that all SOPs and qualification documents reference, to ensure consistency.

blocks.zh: 使用提示
blocks.en: Usage tip

blocks.zh: 在撰寫 OQ/PQ 協議時，應在文件的「定義」章節直接引用 ISPE CTC 指南或 USP 的官方定義，並注明版本。這樣做可以避免在稽查時被質疑術語的依據。
blocks.en: When writing OQ/PQ protocols, cite the official ISPE CTC Guide or USP definitions directly in the "Definitions" section of the document and state the version. This avoids having the basis of your terminology challenged during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：「Cold」、「Cool」、「CRT」、「Freezer」這四個溫度定義直接來自 USP <659>，必須精確使用，不能自行修改溫度範圍。
blocks.en: Note in particular: the four temperature definitions "Cold", "Cool", "CRT" and "Freezer" come directly from USP <659> and must be used exactly; the temperature ranges must not be modified.

blocks.zh: Guard-Banding Concept  |  保護區間概念
blocks.en: Guard-Banding Concept

blocks.zh: 中文：保護區間（Guard-banding）是將驗收標準縮緊以涵蓋測量不確定度（MU）的做法。若 USP 要求 2–8°C，MU = ±0.3°C，則收緊後的驗收標準為 2.3–7.7°C。這樣即使感測器有最大誤差，仍能確保產品實際溫度在規格範圍內。
blocks.en: Commentary: Guard-banding is the practice of tightening the acceptance criteria to cover measurement uncertainty (MU). If USP requires 2–8°C and MU = ±0.3°C, the tightened acceptance criteria are 2.3–7.7°C. This way, even with the maximum sensor error, the actual product temperature is still assured to be within the specification range.

blocks.zh: ISO/IEC Guide 98-3 (GUM) — 即 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement — 是計算 MU 的國際標準方法，也是 ISPE CTC 指南中 guard-banding 計算的理論依據。
blocks.en: ISO/IEC Guide 98-3 (GUM), the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement, is the internationally recognised method for calculating MU and is the theoretical basis for the guard-banding calculation in the ISPE CTC Guide.

blocks.zh: Complete Guide Summary  |  指南完整總覽
blocks.en: Complete Guide Summary

blocks.zh: Guide Overview  |  指南概述
blocks.en: Guide Overview

blocks.zh: 指南核心思想
blocks.en: Core idea of the guide

blocks.zh: ISPE CTC 指南的核心哲學是風險為基礎的生命週期管理——從設計之初就考慮最差情況，以科學和數據支持認證決策，並建立持續監控機制以維持認證狀態。
blocks.en: The core philosophy of the ISPE CTC Guide is risk-based lifecycle management: consider the worst case from the start of design, support qualification decisions with science and data, and establish ongoing monitoring to maintain the qualified state.

blocks.zh: 指南的結構遵循「計畫 → 設計 → 認證 → 運行 → 審查」的生命週期邏輯，每個階段都有明確的文件要求和品保輸出。
blocks.en: The structure of the guide follows the lifecycle logic of "plan → design → qualify → operate → review", with clear documentation requirements and quality assurance outputs at every stage.

blocks.zh: 整體指南的結構比喻
blocks.en: An analogy for the overall structure of the guide

blocks.zh: 這份指南就像一本「受控溫度環境管理的完全手冊」——從「我需要什麼樣的冰箱」（URS）到「如何確認它正常工作」（IQ/OQ/PQ），再到「如何確保它長期保持正常」（監控與定期審查）。
blocks.en: This guide is like a "complete manual for managing controlled temperature environments": from "what kind of refrigerator do I need" (URS), to "how do I confirm it works properly" (IQ/OQ/PQ), to "how do I make sure it keeps working properly over the long term" (monitoring and periodic review).

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，掌握這份指南等同於掌握了客戶稽查（Client Audit）和監管稽查（Regulatory Inspection）時所有冷鏈相關問題的標準答案框架。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, mastering this guide is equivalent to having the standard answer framework for every cold chain question that arises in client audits and regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 2016 版的重要意義
blocks.en: Significance of the 2016 edition

blocks.zh: 2016 版是 ISPE CTC 指南的第一個完整版本（基於 2012 年的 Concept Paper 擴展而來），整合了 EU GDP 2013、ASTM E2500、WHO TRS 961 等最新法規要求，是目前行業最權威的 CTC 認證參考文件之一。
blocks.en: The 2016 edition is the first complete edition of the ISPE CTC Guide (expanded from the 2012 Concept Paper). It integrates the latest regulatory requirements, including EU GDP 2013, ASTM E2500 and WHO TRS 961, and is one of the most authoritative CTC qualification references in the industry today.

blocks.zh: Top 10 Must-Know Principles  |  十大必懂核心原則
blocks.en: Top 10 Must-Know Principles

blocks.zh: 中文：所有認證決策都必須追溯到 URS。URS 是需求與執行之間的橋梁，沒有寫入 URS 的要求不能成為認證失敗的依據；寫入 URS 的要求必須被測試驗證。
blocks.en: Commentary: Every qualification decision must be traceable to the URS. The URS is the bridge between requirements and execution: a requirement not written into the URS cannot be grounds for a qualification failure, and a requirement written into the URS must be tested and verified.

blocks.zh: 中文：溫度映射必須識別最差位置（最熱和最冷點），並在空腔體、滿載、開門等所有相關條件下進行。監控感測器必須放置在映射確認的最差位置——而不是最方便的位置。
blocks.en: Commentary: Temperature mapping must identify the worst-case locations (the hottest and coldest points) and be performed under all relevant conditions, including empty chamber, fully loaded and door-open. Monitoring sensors must be placed at the worst-case locations confirmed by mapping, not at the most convenient locations.

blocks.zh: 中文：每次溫度測量都有不確定度。MU 必須針對完整測量鏈（感測器+線纜+數據採集+校正）計算，並通過保護區間應用於驗收標準。忽略 MU 意味著您的認證數據可能無法真正證明產品溫度在規格範圍內。
blocks.en: Commentary: Every temperature measurement has uncertainty. MU must be calculated for the complete measurement chain (sensor + cabling + data acquisition + calibration) and applied to the acceptance criteria through guard-banding. Ignoring MU means your qualification data may not truly demonstrate that the product temperature is within specification.

blocks.zh: 中文：警示值（Alert）是提前預警，讓操作人員在產品受威脅前採取行動；警報值（Alarm）表示溫度已達到可能影響產品品質的程度。僅設置一個層次是不夠的，兩者之間的間距必須基於 MU、腔體響應時間和產品穩定性數據科學地論證。
blocks.en: Commentary: An alert is an early warning that lets operators act before the product is threatened; an alarm indicates that the temperature has reached a level that may affect product quality. Setting only one level is not enough, and the margin between the two must be scientifically justified based on MU, chamber response time and product stability data.

blocks.zh: 中文：完整的認證生命週期需要五個階段：FAT（廠驗）→ SAT（現場驗收）→ IQ（安裝認證）→ OQ（運行認證）→ PQ（性能認證）。跳過任何一個階段都會產生認證空白，可能在稽查中被指出。
blocks.en: Commentary: A complete qualification lifecycle has five stages: FAT (factory acceptance test) → SAT (site acceptance test) → IQ (installation qualification) → OQ (operational qualification) → PQ (performance qualification). Skipping any stage creates a qualification gap that may be cited in an inspection.

blocks.zh: 中文：滿載腔體的溫度分布與空腔體根本不同。PQ 映射必須在代表性產品負載下進行。裝載配置的重大變更（如容量從 50% 改為 100%、更換包裝格式、增加層架）應觸發是否需要重新認證的評估。
blocks.en: Commentary: The temperature distribution of a fully loaded chamber is fundamentally different from that of an empty chamber. PQ mapping must be performed under a representative product load. A significant change in loading configuration (for example, capacity changing from 50% to 100%, a change of packaging format, or added shelving) should trigger an assessment of whether requalification is needed.

blocks.zh: 中文：所有用於 GMP 決策的電子溫度監控數據（產品放行、偏差調查、批次記錄）必須符合數據完整性要求：稽查跟蹤、訪問控制、備份程序和系統驗證。不合規的數據在 FDA 或 MHRA 稽查中可能被認為不可靠。
blocks.en: Commentary: All electronic temperature monitoring data used for GMP decisions (product release, deviation investigations, batch records) must meet data integrity requirements: audit trails, access control, backup procedures and system validation. Non-compliant data may be regarded as unreliable in an FDA or MHRA inspection.

blocks.zh: 中文：每次溫度偏差都必須在做出放行或拒收決定之前進行調查、記錄和產品影響評估。MKT 計算是偏差影響評估的科學依據——它考慮了溫度與降解速率之間的非線性關係。如果 MKT 仍在規格範圍內，短暫的輕微超溫可能不需要拒收。
blocks.en: Commentary: Every temperature excursion must be investigated, documented and assessed for product impact before a release or rejection decision is made. The MKT calculation is the scientific basis for excursion impact assessment because it accounts for the non-linear relationship between temperature and degradation rate. If the MKT remains within the specification range, a brief, minor excursion may not require rejection.

blocks.zh: 中文：認證不是一次性事件——它是生命週期計畫。年度定期審查必須驗證：無未報告的變更、校正合規性、警報響應性能、溫度偏差趨勢分析和持續的適用性。定期審查的結果應該是正式文件化的結論：「認證狀態維持」或「需要重新認證」。
blocks.en: Commentary: Qualification is not a one-time event; it is a lifecycle programme. The annual periodic review must verify: no unreported changes, calibration compliance, alarm response performance, temperature excursion trend analysis and continued suitability. The outcome of a periodic review should be a formally documented conclusion: "qualified state maintained" or "requalification required".

blocks.zh: 中文：風險為基礎的方法允許對認證範圍決策（更少感測器、更短研究時間、低風險腔體的較少測試）進行科學論證。但這種靈活性需要有文件化的風險評估（FMEA 或等效方法）和明確的理由。沒有文件化風險評估的「風險基礎」只是「做得更少」——這在稽查審查中無法站得住腳。
blocks.en: Commentary: A risk-based approach allows scientific justification of decisions on qualification scope (fewer sensors, shorter studies, less testing for low-risk chambers). But this flexibility requires a documented risk assessment (FMEA or equivalent) and a clear rationale. "Risk-based" without a documented risk assessment is simply "doing less", which cannot be defended in an inspection.

blocks.zh: 查核表使用說明
blocks.en: Checklist instructions

blocks.zh: 本查核表涵蓋 CDMO 冷藏設備認證的完整生命週期。使用場景：(1) 新設備認證計畫、(2) 稽查準備差距評估、(3) 定期審查完整性檢查、(4) 變更控制影響評估。標記 Critical 的項目是監管稽查員例行檢查的重點。
blocks.en: This checklist covers the complete lifecycle of CDMO cold storage equipment qualification. Use cases: (1) a new equipment qualification programme, (2) gap assessment for inspection preparation, (3) completeness check for periodic reviews, (4) change control impact assessment. Items marked Critical are the points that regulatory inspectors routinely check.

blocks.zh: Regulatory Alignment Map  |  法規對應圖
blocks.en: Regulatory Alignment Map

blocks.zh: 法規對應圖的用途
blocks.en: Purpose of the regulatory alignment map

blocks.zh: 稽查員不只依照 ISPE 指南評估 CTC 認證，更會根據各市場的具體法規要求進行審查。本對應圖展示 ISPE CTC 各章節如何對應 EU GDP、WHO TRS 961、FDA 法規和藥典標準，幫助 CDMO 進行有針對性的稽查準備。
blocks.en: Inspectors do not assess CTC qualification only against the ISPE Guide; they also review against the specific regulatory requirements of each market. This map shows how each chapter of the ISPE CTC Guide corresponds to EU GDP, WHO TRS 961, FDA regulations and pharmacopoeial standards, helping a CDMO prepare for inspections in a targeted way.

blocks.zh: Multi-Market Compliance Strategy  |  多市場合規策略
blocks.en: Multi-Market Compliance Strategy

blocks.zh: 推薦策略：以 EU GDP 2013 + WHO TRS 961 + USP <659> + 21 CFR Part 11 為設計基準，一套認證程序即可滿足歐盟、美國、WHO 預認證市場的要求。
blocks.en: Recommended strategy: Use EU GDP 2013 + WHO TRS 961 + USP <659> + 21 CFR Part 11 as the design baseline. A single qualification programme can then satisfy the requirements of the EU, US and WHO prequalification markets.

blocks.zh: 法規優先級類比
blocks.en: An analogy for regulatory priority

blocks.zh: 把法規體系想像成同心圓：最外圈是 WHO TRS 961（全球基線）；中間圈是 EU GDP 和 21 CFR Part 11（主要市場的強制要求）；最內圈是 USP <659> 和 ISPE CTC 指南（具體操作標準）。
blocks.en: Think of the regulatory system as concentric circles: the outermost circle is WHO TRS 961 (the global baseline); the middle circle is EU GDP and 21 CFR Part 11 (mandatory requirements in the major markets); the innermost circle is USP <659> and the ISPE CTC Guide (specific operating standards).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的認證程序應該從最內圈的操作標準開始設計，確保滿足最外圈的全球基線要求——這樣從內到外都有充分的文件支持。
blocks.en: A CDMO's qualification programme should be designed starting from the operating standards in the innermost circle, while making sure the global baseline requirements of the outermost circle are met. This way, there is adequate documented support from the inside out.

blocks.zh: Comprehensive Assessment Questions  |  綜合評量題目
blocks.en: Comprehensive Assessment Questions

blocks.zh: Assessment Purpose  |  評量目的
blocks.en: Assessment Purpose

blocks.zh: 評量使用建議
blocks.en: Suggestions for using the assessment

blocks.zh: 這些題目設計為情境應用題，測試不只是知識記憶，更是在真實 CDMO 場景中應用 ISPE CTC 指南原則的能力。適合作為：團隊培訓討論題、稽查角色扮演練習、完成所有章節後的自我評估。建議以小組討論方式進行，比個人作答更能激發思考深度。
blocks.en: These questions are designed as scenario-based application questions that test not only knowledge recall but also the ability to apply the principles of the ISPE CTC Guide in real CDMO situations. They are suitable as team training discussion questions, inspection role-play exercises, and self-assessment after completing all chapters. We recommend working through them in small group discussions, which stimulate deeper thinking than answering individually.

blocks.zh: Question 1 — Mapping Methodology & Worst-Case Design  |  問題一：映射方法論與最差情況設計
blocks.en: Question 1 — Mapping Methodology & Worst-Case Design

blocks.zh: 情境：您的 CDMO 有一個 200 m² 的冷藏室（2–8°C），用於儲存生物製劑藥品和生物起始材料。該冷藏室使用 3 年，有監控系統但從未進行過正式的溫度映射。EU GDP 稽查員將在 6 個月後到訪。作為驗證經理，您負責設計和執行首次全面性溫度映射研究。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO has a 200 m² cold room (2–8°C) used to store biologic drug products and biological starting materials. The cold room has been in use for 3 years and has a monitoring system, but formal temperature mapping has never been performed. An EU GDP inspector will visit in 6 months. As validation manager, you are responsible for designing and executing the first comprehensive temperature mapping study.

blocks.zh:
Sensor Planning: Using ISPE CTC guidance, determine the minimum number of mapping sensors required for a 200 m² walk-in cold room. Where would you place them, and how would you justify your placement rationale? What are the mandatory locations that must always be included?
感測器規劃：使用 ISPE CTC 指南確定 200 m² 步入式冷藏室所需的最少映射感測器數量。您如何放置它們並論證放置原理？哪些是必須包含的強制性位置？
blocks.en:
Sensor Planning:
Using ISPE CTC guidance, determine the minimum number of mapping sensors required for a 200 m² walk-in cold room. Where would you place them, and how would you justify your placement rationale? What are the mandatory locations that must always be included?

blocks.zh:
Worst-Case Conditions: List all worst-case test conditions that must be included in your OQ mapping protocol. For each condition, explain what makes it a worst case and how you would simulate it in the 200 m² cold room.
最差情況條件：列出必須包含在 OQ 映射協議中的所有最差情況測試條件。對於每種情況，解釋什麼使其成為最差情況，以及如何在 200 m² 冷藏室中模擬它。
blocks.en:
Worst-Case Conditions:
List all worst-case test conditions that must be included in your OQ mapping protocol. For each condition, explain what makes it a worst case and how you would simulate it in the 200 m² cold room.

blocks.zh:
Measurement Uncertainty: Your mapping data logger has a specified accuracy of ±0.3°C. Describe how you would calculate the total Measurement Uncertainty (MU) for the mapping system, and how you would apply guard-banding to the 2–8°C acceptance criteria. Show the mathematical relationship between MU and guard-banded limits.
測量不確定度：您的映射數據記錄器具有 ±0.3°C 的規定精度。描述如何計算映射系統的總測量不確定度（MU），以及如何將保護區間應用於 2–8°C 驗收標準。展示 MU 與保護區間限制之間的數學關係。
blocks.en:
Measurement Uncertainty:
Your mapping data logger has a specified accuracy of ±0.3°C. Describe how you would calculate the total Measurement Uncertainty (MU) for the mapping system, and how you would apply guard-banding to the 2–8°C acceptance criteria. Show the mathematical relationship between MU and guard-banded limits.

blocks.zh:
Inspection Readiness: The EU GDP inspector specifically asks: "Show me your temperature mapping data and explain how you identified the worst-case monitoring sensor location." Walk through the complete chain of evidence you would present, from the mapping protocol to the monitoring sensor placement justification.
稽查準備：EU GDP 稽查員具體詢問：「給我看您的溫度映射數據，並解釋您如何確定最差情況監控感測器位置。」請說明您將呈現的完整證據鏈，從映射協議到監控感測器放置論證。
blocks.en:
Inspection Readiness:
The EU GDP inspector specifically asks: "Show me your temperature mapping data and explain how you identified the worst-case monitoring sensor location." Walk through the complete chain of evidence you would present, from the mapping protocol to the monitoring sensor placement justification.

blocks.en: Model Answer Framework

blocks.zh: Question 2 — Temperature Excursion Investigation & MKT Assessment  |  問題二：溫度偏差調查與 MKT 評估
blocks.en: Question 2 — Temperature Excursion Investigation & MKT Assessment

blocks.zh: 情境：週一凌晨 2:30，BMS 對冷藏室 B（2–8°C，儲存 500 單位單株抗體藥品，保存期限 18 個月）發出警報。監控感測器顯示 11.2°C。值班技術人員在 3:15 到達並確認門封橡膠墊失效。冷藏室在 4:45 恢復至 5°C。連續監控數據顯示上述溫度記錄。
blocks.en: Scenario: At 2:30 a.m. on Monday, the BMS raises an alarm for Cold Room B (2–8°C, storing 500 units of a monoclonal antibody drug product with an 18-month shelf life). The monitoring sensor shows 11.2°C. The on-call technician arrives at 3:15 and confirms that the door seal gasket has failed. The cold room returns to 5°C at 4:45. The continuous monitoring data show the temperature record described above.

blocks.zh:
Immediate Response: What immediate actions should the on-call technician take upon arriving and confirming the excursion? What documentation must be initiated within the first hour? Which SOPs are activated?
即時響應：值班技術人員到達並確認偏差後應立即採取哪些行動？在第一個小時內必須啟動哪些文件？啟動哪些 SOP？
blocks.en:
Immediate Response:
What immediate actions should the on-call technician take upon arriving and confirming the excursion? What documentation must be initiated within the first hour? Which SOPs are activated?

blocks.zh:
MKT Calculation: Using the temperature-time data above and the Arrhenius equation framework described in the ISPE guide, outline how you would calculate the Mean Kinetic Temperature for this excursion. What product stability information would you need to complete the impact assessment? If the product's approved storage condition allows up to 8°C MKT, would this batch likely be acceptable?
MKT 計算：使用上述溫度-時間數據和 ISPE 指南中描述的 Arrhenius 方程框架，概述如何計算此次偏差的平均動能溫度。完成影響評估需要哪些產品穩定性信息？如果產品的批准儲存條件允許 MKT 高達 8°C，這批產品是否可能被接受？
blocks.en:
MKT Calculation:
Using the temperature-time data above and the Arrhenius equation framework described in the ISPE guide, outline how you would calculate the Mean Kinetic Temperature for this excursion. What product stability information would you need to complete the impact assessment? If the product's approved storage condition allows up to 8°C MKT, would this batch likely be acceptable?

blocks.zh:
Root Cause & CAPA: What is the most likely root cause of this excursion? Design a CAPA with at least 3 corrective actions and 2 preventive actions. How would you assess the effectiveness of each CAPA action?
根本原因與 CAPA：此次偏差最可能的根本原因是什麼？設計一個至少包含 3 個糾正措施和 2 個預防措施的 CAPA。如何評估每個 CAPA 措施的有效性？
blocks.en:
Root Cause & CAPA:
What is the most likely root cause of this excursion? Design a CAPA with at least 3 corrective actions and 2 preventive actions. How would you assess the effectiveness of each CAPA action?

blocks.zh:
Regulatory Reporting: Under EU GDP 2013, is this excursion reportable to any regulatory authority? Under what circumstances would a temperature excursion trigger a regulatory notification or Product Quality Review update? What would you include in the client notification for the 500 units stored in this cold room?
法規報告：根據 EU GDP 2013，此次偏差是否需要向任何監管機關報告？在什麼情況下溫度偏差會觸發法規通知或產品品質回顧更新？您會在對儲存在此冷藏室的 500 單位的客戶通知中包含哪些內容？
blocks.en:
Regulatory Reporting:
Under EU GDP 2013, is this excursion reportable to any regulatory authority? Under what circumstances would a temperature excursion trigger a regulatory notification or Product Quality Review update? What would you include in the client notification for the 500 units stored in this cold room?

blocks.en: Key Concepts to Address

blocks.zh: Question 3 — Guide Integration & Lifecycle Strategy for a New CDMO CTC Programme  |  問題三：新 CDMO CTC 計畫的指南整合與生命週期策略
blocks.en: Question 3 — Guide Integration & Lifecycle Strategy for a New CDMO CTC Programme

blocks.zh: 情境：您剛被任命為一家成長中的無菌充填 CDMO 的驗證主管。公司目前有：(1) 2 個穩定性腔體（25°C/60%RH 和 40°C/75%RH）、(2) 1 個冰箱（2–8°C，500L）、(3) 1 個 -20°C 冷凍庫（200L）、(4) 1 個步入式冷藏室（2–8°C，50 m²）。這些設備都沒有正式的認證。CEO 要求您以 ISPE CTC 指南為主要框架，從零開始建立完整的 CTC 認證計畫。
blocks.en: Scenario: You have just been appointed Head of Validation at a growing sterile fill-finish CDMO. The company currently has: (1) 2 stability chambers (25°C/60%RH and 40°C/75%RH), (2) 1 refrigerator (2–8°C, 500 L), (3) 1 -20°C freezer (200 L), and (4) 1 walk-in cold room (2–8°C, 50 m²). None of this equipment has been formally qualified. The CEO asks you to build a complete CTC qualification programme from scratch, using the ISPE CTC Guide as the primary framework.

blocks.zh:
Prioritisation Strategy: Using a risk-based approach (referencing ICH Q9 and ISPE CTC guidance), in what order would you prioritise the qualification of the 5 CTCs listed above? Justify your prioritisation based on: (a) regulatory criticality, (b) product impact risk, (c) current qualification status, and (d) business need. Create a prioritised project plan with approximate timelines.
優先化策略：使用風險基礎方法（參照 ICH Q9 和 ISPE CTC 指南），您會以什麼順序優先認證上述 5 個 CTC 設備？基於以下方面論證您的優先化：(a) 法規關鍵性、(b) 產品影響風險、(c) 當前認證狀態、(d) 業務需求。創建帶有大致時程的優先化項目計畫。
blocks.en:
Prioritisation Strategy:
Using a risk-based approach (referencing ICH Q9 and ISPE CTC guidance), in what order would you prioritise the qualification of the 5 CTCs listed above? Justify your prioritisation based on: (a) regulatory criticality, (b) product impact risk, (c) current qualification status, and (d) business need. Create a prioritised project plan with approximate timelines.

blocks.zh:
Reference & Standards Alignment: From Appendix 8 of the ISPE CTC Guide, identify which 6 references are most critical for your qualification programme. For each, explain specifically how it applies to at least one of the 5 CTCs in your facility.
參考文獻與標準對應：從 ISPE CTC 指南的附錄 8 中，識別對您的認證計畫最關鍵的 6 個參考文獻。對每個文獻，具體說明它如何適用於您設施中 5 個 CTC 中的至少一個。
blocks.en:
Reference & Standards Alignment:
From Appendix 8 of the ISPE CTC Guide, identify which 6 references are most critical for your qualification programme. For each, explain specifically how it applies to at least one of the 5 CTCs in your facility.

blocks.zh:
Glossary Application: Five ISPE CTC Guide terms will be central to the qualification protocols you write. For each of the following terms, write one sentence showing how it applies to your specific facility context: (a) URS, (b) Worst-Case Location, (c) MKT, (d) Guard-Banding, (e) Periodic Review.
術語應用：五個 ISPE CTC 指南術語將是您撰寫認證協議的核心。對以下每個術語，寫一句話說明它如何適用於您的具體設施環境：(a) URS、(b) 最差位置、(c) MKT、(d) 保護區間、(e) 定期審查。
blocks.en:
Glossary Application:
Five ISPE CTC Guide terms will be central to the qualification protocols you write. For each of the following terms, write one sentence showing how it applies to your specific facility context: (a) URS, (b) Worst-Case Location, (c) MKT, (d) Guard-Banding, (e) Periodic Review.

blocks.zh:
Programme Architecture: Design the complete document architecture for your CTC qualification programme. List all the SOPs, protocols, reports, and ongoing monitoring procedures you would need to create. Organise them by lifecycle phase (URS → Qualification → Operations → Periodic Review). How does this document architecture align with EU GDP and FDA documentation requirements?
計畫架構：設計您的 CTC 認證計畫的完整文件架構。列出您需要創建的所有 SOP、協議、報告和持續監控程序。按生命週期階段組織它們（URS → 認證 → 運行 → 定期審查）。這個文件架構如何與 EU GDP 和 FDA 文件要求對應？
blocks.en:
Programme Architecture:
Design the complete document architecture for your CTC qualification programme. List all the SOPs, protocols, reports, and ongoing monitoring procedures you would need to create. Organise them by lifecycle phase (URS → Qualification → Operations → Periodic Review). How does this document architecture align with EU GDP and FDA documentation requirements?

blocks.zh: Bonus Question — Regulatory Intelligence  |  加分題：法規情報
blocks.en: Bonus Question — Regulatory Intelligence

blocks.zh: 短答題（Short Answer）：以下每題限 2–3 句話回答
blocks.en: Short Answer: Answer each question below in 2–3 sentences

blocks.zh:
What is the difference between a "Cold" storage condition and a "Controlled Cold Temperature (CCT)" condition per the ISPE CTC Guide? In what business scenario is CCT more relevant than Cold?
根據 ISPE CTC 指南，「Cold」儲存條件和「受控冷藏溫度（CCT）」條件有什麼區別？在什麼業務場景中 CCT 比 Cold 更相關？
blocks.en: What is the difference between a "Cold" storage condition and a "Controlled Cold Temperature (CCT)" condition per the ISPE CTC Guide? In what business scenario is CCT more relevant than Cold?

blocks.zh:
Why must monitoring sensors be placed at the worst-case location from mapping, rather than near the temperature controller sensor? What is the risk if they are in the same location?
為什麼監控感測器必須放置在映射中確認的最差位置，而不是靠近溫度控制器感測器？如果它們在同一位置，風險是什麼？
blocks.en: Why must monitoring sensors be placed at the worst-case location from mapping, rather than near the temperature controller sensor? What is the risk if they are in the same location?

blocks.zh:
An FDA investigator asks you to explain why your OQ mapping acceptance criteria are ±0.5°C tighter than the USP <659> specification limits. What is your answer?
FDA 調查員要求您解釋為什麼您的 OQ 映射驗收標準比 USP <659> 規格限制嚴格 ±0.5°C。您的回答是什麼？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator asks you to explain why your OQ mapping acceptance criteria are ±0.5°C tighter than the USP <659> specification limits. What is your answer?

blocks.zh:
What triggers a mandatory requalification of a CTC according to the ISPE CTC Guide? List at least 5 triggering events.
根據 ISPE CTC 指南，什麼觸發 CTC 的強制重新認證？列出至少 5 個觸發事件。
blocks.en: What triggers a mandatory requalification of a CTC according to the ISPE CTC Guide? List at least 5 triggering events.
